hypothesis: Reducing expected sampling mass of added SimpleStories rows to 10 percent reduces narrative bias without destroying natural novel everyday generation. Source membership is not a genre label.
comparison: same 100k rows, vocabulary, four-layer shape, seed, initialization, steps and generation policy; only hierarchical sampling differs
review: 100 randomly selected outputs per condition at fresh 940000 seed; Codex agent reviews naturalness, reading and explicit fiction_or_narrative framing. Not independent human review. Natural nonexact everyday outputs are an exploratory joint measure.
genre_policy: fiction_or_narrative=true for explicit fantasy/anthropomorphism or a staged story scene involving named archetypal actors (boy/girl/king etc), plot or emotional narrative. Plain observations, requests, explanations and first-person real-life reports are false. Ambiguous cases recorded in notes; this is subjective, not a full narrative classifier.
default_model: unchanged; no adoption without existing gates
limitations: Source reweighting does not add missing non-fiction texts and may increase memorization of original smaller pool. 10 percent refers only to added stories source.
